scope: Behavioral subset of AAP broker Level 1 not covered by token-only aap-conformance.

requirements.rule: Absent a matching broker policy clause, grant resolution is denied.
Credential material, backend addresses, and provider identity do not enter the agent-visible response.
Unknown grant, policy denial, and provider failure are indistinguishable through the agent-visible denial surface.
Success and denial paths produce broker-side signed audit evidence without credential material.
On success, only the operation result crosses back to the agent-visible side.

non_goals: AAP token/JWS verification already covered by aap-conformance
claiming official OpenA2A or IETF conformance
